calculation.description: Compute a five-session lagged reversal normalized by lagged 30-session idiosyncratic volatility and multiplied by a lagged high-dispersion regime gate. Convert to cross-sectional percentile ranks, average today's lagged rank with the prior rank, then demean cross-sectionally. All inputs are lagged and the forward horizon is ten trading sessions.

validation.regime_notes: Passed benchmark-wide absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840 on 1,997 daily cross-sectional observations with all 15 tradable assets. Recent 365d and 750d ICIR pass directionally, while the 1,260d window is weaker; uncertainty is material in the 15-asset cross-section.

provenance.method: lagged OHLC close-only daily panel; Spearman cross-sectional IC; dates with at least 8 valid instruments
